description: a wrought-iron street lantern on a dark post with a basket of red geraniums hanging below the lamp. It belongs to a district of the town with this look, which everything in the district shares: An alpine Bavarian village: white plastered houses with dark carved wooden balconies full of red geraniums, green shutters, painted frames around the windows, wooden shingle roofs, blue-and-white lozenge flags; cosy and festive.
